notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on giampaolo/psutil at parent commit 1ae01d1210f73b411d38c0b7dc365727ae07608d (real upstream issue #2793, fixed upstream at 73a2bfb9152b20a85b4ea51d71b5d139c174aa02): process_iter() catches attribute-prefetch failures with `except NoSuchProcess: remove(pid)`, and because ZombieProcess subclasses NoSuchProcess, processes in the zombie state are silently dropped from the enumeration and the internal cache, even though they remain queryable through psutil.Process(pid). The image clones the repo at the parent (shallow, detached), editable-installs it so pure-Python edits take effect immediately, keeps the fix commit unreachable (fetched only into a deleted throwaway bare clone; verified with `! git cat-file -e <fix>^{commit}` in the image), and ships the golden test test_zombie_process_is_not_skipped extracted from the fix commit (sha-asserted) in /opt/golden and overlaid on the pristine /opt/psutil-prefix snapshot. The reproduction is NOT provided: the agent must author its own deterministic failing reproduction (/app/reproduce_zombie_skip.py) as a deliverable. The task is deliberately harder than the mined delta alone, because the naive reproduction (creating a real zombie via fork+_exit) does NOT discriminate: as_dict() absorbs ZombieProcess per attribute, so a real zombie is yielded by both trees; the observable difference is a prefetch that raises the zombie condition outright, which the agent must discover from the source and construct deterministically. The verifier runs the agent's reproduction against the pristine pre-fix environment (/opt/prefix-venv, isolated because pip editable installs hook sys.meta_path and shadow PYTHONPATH) and against the repaired tree; runs the upstream golden test in both directions; runs two discriminating hidden cases from inputs the upstream test does not use (three simultaneous zombie-condition processes with cache-instance retention and pid-sorted output; attrs=('pid','create_time') with ad_value and instance-identity assertions) plus a regression guard (mocked NoSuchProcess must still drop/remove, so an over-broad except-everything fix fails); and requires the whole TestProcessIter class green. Measured: full tests/test_system.py ~22s at 1 CPU; image build ~1 minute; verification path ~60s.
